jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist - EMEA
jobs.description: Mize provides AI-driven revenue infrastructure for travel companies. Our technology enhances every step of the booking cycle and every vertical you sell. By combining predictive algorithms, synthetic availability, dynamic liquidity and a powerful rules engine, Mize helps travel brands unlock new revenue, stabilize their margins and scale their operations.With 10 years in the industry, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, Mize supports 350+ clients worldwide and has generated hundreds of millions in incremental profit for the travel industry.We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist that will be part of our global tech-support team, will work closely with our operations team on our flag product maintenance and daily operations while assisting the entire R&D team. If you voluntarily provide us with additional Personal Information, such as information about your gender, racial or ethnic origin, health condition or military service, we will process that information as well. Personal Information may also include recommendation letters, names and contact details for references. Please note that it is your responsibility to obtain consent from your references prior to providing us personal information about them. You are not under any legal obligation to provide us Personal Information. However, we do need it to consider your job application. The Company collects Personal Information about Applicants from a number of sources, including directly from you, from references, from the recruiting manager(s), and from third-party recruitment platforms such as LinkedIn, Glass Door and DrushimIL. Should your application be successful, relevant data will be transferred to our HR information system in accordance with the Company’s internal privacy policy. Your Personal Information will be Processed for the purposes and on the bases detailed below. We may Process the Personal Information for additional purposes, provided that we provide accordant notice to you, and provided that we receive your consent, if so required.
